third_party_evaluations.summary: PIMS Lead Implementer for organisations operationalising ISO/IEC 27701.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Operationalizing a privacy management system with a three-year profile supports professional implementation responsibility; recorded accreditation does not independently demonstrate broader expert privacy engineering.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The recorded PIMS implementation role, accreditation and three-year profile support professional privacy-management knowledge. Independent implementation performance is not specified, so the lead title is not sufficient evidence of expert delivery.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded operationalization of privacy management under ISO 27701 supports professional advisory and implementation knowledge at three years. No extended practical assessment or expert-level authority is documented.
